acceptanceCriteria: TaskOutcomeEvent retains repository/work-item identity and strict unknown-field rejection

Supported event families include finding, risk, warning, confirmation, stop, resume, resolution, risk-accepted, check-pass-after-fix, prevention, completed, and cancelled with explicit correction/supersession relationships
Finding events carry a deterministic findingFingerprint and duplicate fingerprints are not emitted unless an explicit post-fix recurrence is recorded

Generated report sections produce corresponding append-only events for findings, risks, warnings, stops, resolutions, recurrence prevention, avoided impact, residual risks, completion, and cancellation without inventing authority or benefits
Validator rejects malformed, foreign, unsafe, duplicate, out-of-order relationship, and unknown event-family records while preserving historical valid streams
Three-language docs describe semantic mapping, original contract language preservation, conditional avoided impact, privacy/no-score rules, and non-wire compatibility
Focused Rust tests and cargo test --locked --workspace pass
goal: 让事件流能表达参考源要求的 finding/risk/warning/confirmation/stop/resume/resolution/risk-accepted/check-pass-after-fix/prevention/completed/cancelled 语义，重复 finding 可确定性去重，修正只能追加，生成与校验覆盖新增事件族，并在三语文档中明确 Rust 语义映射与非 wire 兼容边界。
intent: 将参考源 Task Outcome Events 的可审计事件族、finding 去重、correction/supersession 与生成/校验边界语义对齐到 Rust Runtime，同时保持 Rust-native wire shape 与历史事件可读性。
